description: Break down traffic by how the site appears in Google Search: organic web results, rich results, AMP, image search, video, news, etc. Shows which search features are driving impressions and clicks. Requires Google Search Console to be connected. Direct the user to rankparse.com/dashboard/integrations to connect it. When several Google accounts are connected, the property is read through the account that can see it.
name: get_gsc_search_appearance
